# Historical EventBus restart fixtures

Generated by `python3 tests/fixtures/restart-spool/generate.py` using the actual
`netbaiot-protocol/src/lib.rs` and `SpoolRecord` Rust definitions from commit
`8ec59f37530659d65fe4ea398aba831b156d1d6b` (before configuration ownership removal).
The generator copies those sources into a temporary, standalone crate; no legacy
domain types are compiled into the current gateway. Requires cached Cargo dependencies
and Rust 1.88.0. Output is deterministic and contains only synthetic public test data.

The framing reproduces that revision's `spool.rs`: `NBSP`, big-endian u32 version,
v2-only big-endian u64 generation (7), then for each record a big-endian u32 JSON
length, the historical serde JSON bytes, and SHA-256 of those bytes.

- `config-ack-v{1,2}.spool`: one removed configuration acknowledgement.
- `supported-v{1,2}.spool`: heartbeat, telemetry, and command acknowledgement,
  preserving fixed event IDs, pending sink, routing revision, and retry attempts.

The runtime tests use both legacy append-only and authoritative snapshot paths.
The server subprocess test uses the v2 fixture to verify startup refusal and an
operator-facing diagnostic without logging record contents. Failed recovery leaves
the fixture bytes intact so the previous release can still consume them.
